observation: Captured in open-4 (siteId warm_freighter, strainId charon_grave, driveState drift, draws 9, size 14.92 x 7.00 x 47.65 WU). decision: disposition: needs follow-up — featureless 8x6 low-poly sphere beads, oversized faceted glowing orange sphere head with no fin/jaw detail, and chase/close framing clips.
next: Rebuild as a continuous sculpted/folded sinuous wake-eel body with streamlined wake-fins, sculpted head with restrained sensory glow, and verify chase framing and trail motion, then recapture.
